_meta.purpose: Authored recaps, part 2 — the 104 lessons that previously fell back to extraction.
_meta.why: Derived questions exist only in English (comprehension_check parses English prose), so a Swahili or French child got no recap at all. Authoring them makes every readable lesson's recap translatable.
_meta.rules: Same as part 1: a prompt never contains its own answer, two questions minimum, options short and plausible.
